disclaimer_zh: 本矩阵把既有场景节点与概念验收门建立审查映射，仅用于设计沟通与试点证据规划；不是政府审批、运营承诺或官方空间边界。
disclaimer_en: This matrix maps existing scenario nodes to conceptual acceptance gates for design review and pilot evidence planning only; it is not a government approval, operating commitment, or official spatial boundary.

items.area_name_zh: 众智园 AI 自主创新加速区
items.problem_zh: 技术方案可能先于真实日常需求进入试点。
items.problem_en: Technical solutions may enter pilots before a real everyday need is established.
items.spatial_response_zh: 在众智园公共界面设置有人值守的需求登记与非 AI 办理入口。
items.spatial_response_en: Place a staffed needs-intake and non-AI service point at Zhongzhiyuan's public interface.
items.evidence_to_collect_zh: 自愿需求记录、最小字段清单、非 AI 替代流程与运营/合规复核记录。
items.evidence_to_collect_en: Voluntary need records, minimum-field list, non-AI alternative flow, and operator/compliance review records.
items.public_value_zh: 防止“先有技术后找场景”。

items.area_name_zh: 众智园 AI 自主创新加速区
items.problem_zh: 服务输出缺少稳定性记录与可追责链条。
items.problem_en: Service outputs may lack stability records and an accountable trace chain.
items.spatial_response_zh: 以开放工坊和质量追溯庭院承载测试、复核与公开说明。
items.spatial_response_en: Use an open workshop and quality-trace courtyard for testing, review, and public explanation.
items.evidence_to_collect_zh: 测试记录、质量问题、责任链、异常关闭与专业复核记录。
items.evidence_to_collect_en: Test records, quality issues, accountability chain, incident closure, and professional review records.
items.public_value_zh: 让服务结果可解释、可追责。
items.public_value_en: Make service results explainable and accountable.

items.area_name_zh: 众智园 AI 自主创新加速区
items.problem_zh: 跨系统服务可能在安全、接口或退出条件未验证时外溢到公共场景。
items.problem_en: Cross-system services may spill into public settings before safety, interfaces, or exits are verified.
items.spatial_response_zh: 设置与公共活动分隔、可停止的合成测试和互操作验证空间。
items.spatial_response_en: Provide a stoppable synthetic-test and interoperability space separated from public activity.
items.evidence_to_collect_zh: 公开规范、合成测试、授权数据说明、安全复核与接管记录。
items.evidence_to_collect_en: Public specifications, synthetic tests, authorized-data notes, safety review, and takeover records.
items.public_value_zh: 在公共部署前检查跨系统接口与退出机制。
items.public_value_en: Check cross-system interfaces and exits before public deployment.

items.area_name_zh: 北京 AI 原点社区
items.problem_zh: 人才服务可能依据想象画像而非可公开说明的日常缺口。
items.problem_en: Talent services may be based on imagined profiles rather than explainable everyday gaps.
items.spatial_response_zh: 在近校生活路径设置自愿、低门槛、有人值守的需求站。
items.spatial_response_en: Place a voluntary, low-barrier, staffed needs station along near-campus daily routes.
items.evidence_to_collect_zh: 自愿选择、聚合需求、最小字段、人工受理与非 AI 路径记录。
items.evidence_to_collect_en: Voluntary choices, aggregated needs, minimum fields, staffed intake, and non-AI route records.

items.area_name_zh: 北京 AI 原点社区
items.problem_zh: 拒绝 AI、撤回同意或没有设备的人可能被排除在服务之外。
items.problem_en: People who decline AI, withdraw consent, or lack a device may be excluded from service.
items.spatial_response_zh: 把明示规则、撤回、人工办理和纸质替代放在同一可见服务台。
items.spatial_response_en: Co-locate disclosed rules, withdrawal, staffed processing, and paper alternatives at one visible desk.
items.evidence_to_collect_zh: 同意与撤回记录、人工/纸质流程、可用时段、等待时间与纠错记录。
items.evidence_to_collect_en: Consent and withdrawal records, staffed/paper flow, service hours, waiting time, and correction records.
items.public_value_zh: 保证拒绝 AI 后仍可获得等价服务。
items.public_value_en: Preserve equivalent service after AI is declined.

items.area_name_zh: 北京 AI 原点社区
items.problem_zh: 服务争议和使用障碍可能无法进入下一轮决策。
items.problem_en: Service disputes and access barriers may fail to influence the next decision cycle.
items.spatial_response_zh: 设置可匿名或实名自选、带人工复核和公开复盘的反馈论坛。
items.spatial_response_en: Provide a feedback forum with optional anonymity, human review, and public retrospectives.
items.evidence_to_collect_zh: 反馈工单、响应时间、整改、关闭记录与下一轮决定。
items.evidence_to_collect_en: Feedback tickets, response time, remediation, closure records, and next-cycle decisions.
items.public_value_zh: 把争议和改进纳入下一轮。
items.public_value_en: Carry disputes and improvements into the next cycle.

items.area_name_zh: 北京 AI 原点社区
items.problem_zh: 长期公共贡献容易被短期商业曝光取代。
items.problem_en: Long-term public contribution can be displaced by short-term commercial visibility.
items.spatial_response_zh: 以自愿署名、人工策展和可更正的公共展示带记录贡献。
items.spatial_response_en: Record contributions through a public ribbon with voluntary attribution, human curation, and correction.
items.evidence_to_collect_zh: 自愿公开授权、事实核验、版权复核、更正与撤下记录。
items.evidence_to_collect_en: Voluntary publication consent, factual verification, copyright review, correction, and removal records.
items.public_value_zh: 让长期公共贡献被记忆。

items.area_name_zh: 大钟寺 AI 产业聚集区
items.problem_zh: 企业难以找到公开、合规且责任清楚的专业服务入口。
items.problem_en: Enterprises may struggle to find public, compliant professional services with clear accountability.
items.spatial_response_zh: 在大钟寺城市客厅设置公开目录与专业人员复核的接口台。
items.spatial_response_en: Place a public-directory interface with professional review in the Dazhongsi urban hall.
items.evidence_to_collect_zh: 公开政策与服务目录、适用边界、责任角色、转介与纠错记录。
items.evidence_to_collect_en: Public policy and service directories, applicability boundaries, accountable roles, referrals, and correction records.
items.public_value_zh: 降低寻找合规服务的成本。
items.public_value_en: Lower the cost of finding compliant services.

items.area_name_zh: 大钟寺 AI 产业聚集区
items.problem_zh: 固定服务组合难以适应不同时段和人群，且可能形成强制消费。
items.problem_en: Fixed service mixes may not fit different times and users and can become mandatory consumption.
items.spatial_response_zh: 以可逆布置、现场选择、人工服务和非消费停留空间组成城市客厅。
items.spatial_response_en: Use reversible layouts, on-site choice, staffed service, and non-commercial dwell space in the urban hall.
items.evidence_to_collect_zh: 公开目录、时段规则、人工服务、价格公平抽查与投诉处理记录。
items.evidence_to_collect_en: Public directory, time rules, staffed service, price-equity samples, and complaint-resolution records.
items.public_value_zh: 让服务组合随时段和人群调整。
items.public_value_en: Adapt service combinations by time and user group.

items.area_name_zh: 大钟寺 AI 产业聚集区
items.problem_zh: 单点演示成功可能被误当作片区扩容依据。
items.problem_en: A successful one-off demonstration may be mistaken for evidence to scale across a district.
items.spatial_response_zh: 设置跨专业复核台，集中审阅试点、公众反馈、风险和退出证据。
items.spatial_response_en: Use a multidisciplinary review desk to examine pilot, public-feedback, risk, and exit evidence together.
items.evidence_to_collect_zh: G1–G4 记录、重大异常关闭、救济可用性、回退方案与扩容决定。
items.evidence_to_collect_en: G1-G4 records, major-incident closure, remedy availability, rollback plan, and scale decision.
items.public_value_zh: 防止未经验证直接扩大部署。

items.problem_zh: 文化导览可能混淆史实、生成内容与商业传播。
items.problem_en: Cultural guidance may blur historical fact, generated content, and commercial promotion.
items.spatial_response_zh: 在公共轴设置双语、可解释、可更正并有人复核的导览节点。
items.spatial_response_en: Place bilingual, explainable, correctable, human-reviewed guide points along the public axis.
items.evidence_to_collect_zh: 公开史料、策展来源、事实与版权复核、生成内容标识和更正记录。
items.evidence_to_collect_en: Public historical sources, curatorial provenance, factual/copyright review, synthetic labels, and corrections.
items.public_value_zh: 连接铁路历史与可信 AI 新文化。
items.public_value_en: Connect railway history with a trustworthy AI culture.

items.name_zh: 无障碍慢行与健康导航
items.problem_zh: 未经现场核验的导航可能忽略过街、坡度、障碍和人工求助。
items.problem_en: Navigation without field verification may miss crossings, slopes, barriers, and human assistance.
items.spatial_response_zh: 在公共轴布置连续无障碍提示、休息点、有人求助和非数字路线。
items.spatial_response_en: Provide continuous accessible cues, rest points, staffed help, and a non-digital route along the public axis.
items.evidence_to_collect_zh: 现场无障碍审计、入口/过街/坡度核验、服务信息、人工复核与问题关闭记录。
items.evidence_to_collect_en: Field accessibility audit, entrance/crossing/slope checks, service information, human review, and issue closure.
items.public_value_zh: 降低日常服务障碍，同时避免把概念缓冲区当真实可达性。
items.public_value_en: Reduce everyday service barriers without treating concept buffers as real accessibility.
